headlines.reliable: Nothing worrying stood out on this page.
headlines.concerns: Mostly fine, but a few things are worth a closer look before you buy.
headlines.careful: Look closely at the seller and the reviews before you buy.
headlines.junk_or_scam: This looks like generic factory goods, or an offer that isn't what it seems.

timer_resets.title: Fake countdown
timer_resets.detail: This countdown restarts when you reload the page: the deadline isn't real.

fake_urgency_app.title: Urgency tricks
fake_urgency_app.detail: The shop uses {app}, a tool for countdowns or 'someone just bought this' pop-ups that create pressure.

countdown.title: Countdown timer
countdown.detail: A countdown timer pushes you to decide quickly.

preticked_addon.title: Paid extra already ticked
preticked_addon.detail: A paid extra is ticked for you in advance ({label}). That's not allowed in the EU: untick it if you don't want it.

drip_pricing.title: Price goes up at checkout
drip_pricing.detail: At checkout the total is {pct} higher than the price on the page.

late_fees.title: Costs revealed later
late_fees.detail: Some costs (such as shipping or fees) only appear at checkout.

review_velocity.title: Suspicious number of reviews
review_velocity.detail: {count} ratings for a product that's only been listed for {age}.

review_shape.title: Unnatural rating pattern
review_shape.detail: Almost only 5-star and 1-star ratings, hardly anything in between: a pattern often seen with bought reviews.

duplicate_reviews.title: Copy-paste reviews
duplicate_reviews.detail: {pct} of the reviews repeat another review almost word for word.

off_topic_reviews.title: Reviews about something else
off_topic_reviews.detail: {pct} of the reviews don't seem to be about this product: they may have been carried over from another listing.

review_import_app.title: Imported reviews
review_import_app.detail: The shop uses a tool that copies reviews from other sites, such as AliExpress.

word_soup.title: Title full of search terms
word_soup.detail: The title is a string of search terms rather than a product name: typical of generic factory goods.

generic_brand.title: Unknown brand
generic_brand.detail: {brand} isn't a recognizable brand: usually a sign of generic factory goods sold under a made-up name.

generic_product.title: Generic product
generic_product.detail: This looks like a generic product that's also sold elsewhere under other names, often for less.

implausible_claims.title: Hard-to-believe claims
implausible_claims.detail: The page makes claims that are hard to believe for this product: {claim}.

pushy_copy.title: Pushy sales talk
pushy_copy.detail: The text uses pressure tactics, such as scarcity or 'today only' offers.

big_discount.title: Too-good discount
big_discount.detail: A {pct} discount on a 'was' price that may never have been charged.

was_never_charged.title: 'Was' price not charged recently
was_never_charged.detail: This product sold for {low} in the past 30 days, yet the 'was' price is {was}.

implausible_discount.title: Unbelievable discount
implausible_discount.detail: {pct} off: discounts this deep are almost always measured against a price nobody paid.

reference_anchor.title: Discount on a 'recommended' price
reference_anchor.detail: The 'was' price is labelled {anchor}: a reference price, not what this shop charged before.

permanent_sale.title: Never-ending sale
permanent_sale.detail: The page says {phrase}: shops that are always closing down use this to rush you.

seller_not_brand.title: Sold by another company
seller_not_brand.detail: Sold by {seller}, not by the brand itself.

ships_from_far.title: Ships from far away
ships_from_far.detail: Ships from {place}: expect long delivery times, and returns can be hard.

dropshipping_tools.title: Dropshipping
dropshipping_tools.detail: The shop uses dropshipping tools: products are shipped straight from a supplier.

supplier_links.title: Supplier traces
supplier_links.detail: The page contains links or images from wholesale sites such as AliExpress or Temu.

missing_trust_info.title: Little shop information
missing_trust_info.detail: No clear return policy, contact details or company information.

no_withdrawal.title: No return policy found
no_withdrawal.detail: No return or withdrawal policy found, though EU shops must offer one.

no_imprint.title: No company details
no_imprint.detail: No company name or address found {where}.

invalid_vat.title: Invalid VAT number
invalid_vat.detail: The VAT number shown isn't a real one: it isn't valid in the EU register, or couldn't exist at all.

new_domain.title: Brand-new web shop
new_domain.detail: This web shop's address was registered only {age} ago.

short_registration.title: New, short registration
short_registration.detail: The shop's web address was registered less than a year ago, and only for one year: short-lived shops are often set up this way.

hidden_ai_text.title: Hidden text to fool checks
hidden_ai_text.detail: The page hides text aimed at AI tools, to influence checks like this one.

ai_text.title: Text aimed at AI
ai_text.detail: The page contains text that addresses AI tools or rating systems.

overall.title: Several small signals
overall.detail: No single big problem, but several smaller signals together lowered the score.

returns_abroad.title: Returns go abroad
returns_abroad.detail: Returns have to be sent to {place}: slow, expensive, and often not worth it.

return_address_withheld.title: No return address
return_address_withheld.detail: The shop only gives a return address when you ask for one: common with shops that don't hold their own stock.

restocking_fee.title: Costly returns
restocking_fee.detail: Returning an item costs a {pct} restocking fee.

origin_doubt.title: 'Made in USA' doubtful
origin_doubt.detail: The page says 'Made in USA', but the goods ship from overseas.

long_delivery.title: Long delivery time
long_delivery.detail: Delivery can take up to {days} days: typical of goods shipped straight from an overseas supplier.

mailbox_address.title: Mailbox address only
mailbox_address.detail: The only address shown is a mailbox (PO Box or PMB), not a place of business.

no_return_policy.title: No return policy found
no_return_policy.detail: No return policy found on the page.

brand_photo_reused.title: Photo of another, known brand
brand_photo_reused.detail: The main product photo is the {catalogue_brand} brand's own photo of its product, but this page sells it as {brand}. That points to a copied listing, or a copy of the product.

rebranded_photo.title: Same photo under other brand names
rebranded_photo.detail: The main product photo is the same photo as on other listings that sell it under {many}: {names}. The same product under several brand names is usually generic goods, relabelled.

photo_reused.title: Same photo on other shops
photo_reused.detail: The main product photo is the same photo as on {count} other {shops} ({names}). With the other signals, that points to a resold supplier product.

linked_new_shops.title: Linked to new shops
linked_new_shops.detail: This shop shares accounts (such as an advertising pixel or payment account) with {count} {shops} registered in the last six months: {names}.

safety_gate_alert.title: On the EU list of dangerous products
safety_gate_alert.detail: The EU's Safety Gate, where authorities warn about dangerous products, has an alert for this product: {alert}

irreversible_payment_only.title: Only payments you can't get back
irreversible_payment_only.detail: The shop mentions {methods} and no card, PayPal or other method with buyer protection. Money sent that way can't be reclaimed if nothing arrives.

founded_contradicted.title: Says it's long-established, but the site is new
founded_contradicted.detail: The shop says {claim}, but its web address has existed for only {age}.

far_below_market.title: Far below the usual price
far_below_market.detail: This product (same barcode) costs {pct} less here than the typical price at {count} other {shops} we've seen in the last three months. Prices that low often mean a fake, or an order that never arrives.

origin_contradicted.title: Not where it says it is
origin_contradicted.detail: The shop says {claim}, but the only address it gives is in {place}.

copied_reviews_elsewhere.title: Reviews copied from other shops
copied_reviews_elsewhere.detail: {copied} of the {checked} longer reviews here appear word for word on {count} other {shops}.

brand_no_presence.title: A brand with no presence of its own
brand_no_presence.detail: We found no record of {brand} anywhere else: no entry in Wikidata and no website under its name. With the other signals, that points to generic goods sold under a made-up name.

store_without_address.title: Mentions a store, gives no address
store_without_address.detail: The shop says {claim}, but gives no address anywhere on the page.

shared_address.title: Address shared by many shops
shared_address.detail: The shop's address is also given by {count} other unrelated web shops we've seen: typical of a virtual office or a mail-forwarding address, not the shop's own premises.

doorway_pages.title: Pages for many towns, no address
doorway_pages.detail: The site has landing pages for {count} towns but no street address in any of them. Call centres that pose as local businesses often work this way: check where the company really is before you hire.

linked_sites.title: Same company behind other sites
linked_sites.detail: This site shares a phone number, e-mail domain or tracking ID with {count} other {sites} ({names}): one company may run them all under different local names.

copied_photo.title: Photo also on other sites
copied_photo.detail: A photo on this page also appears on {count} other {sites} ({names}), so it may not show this company's own work.

premium_number.title: Premium-rate phone number
premium_number.detail: The phone number is a premium-rate one: you pay extra per minute just to call. Look for a regular number.

upfront_payment.title: Payment before the work
upfront_payment.detail: The page asks for payment in full or a large deposit before the work starts ({quote}). Pay for work once it's done, or for materials against a receipt.

cash_only.title: Cash only
cash_only.detail: The page says it only takes cash ({quote}). Cash leaves you no way to get your money back if something goes wrong.

quote_on_site.title: Price only on the doorstep
quote_on_site.detail: The price is only set once someone is at your door ({quote}). Ask for a written price before they start.

new_site.title: Brand-new website
new_site.detail: This website's address was registered only {age} ago.

copied_testimonials.title: Copy-paste testimonials
copied_testimonials.detail: Most of the {count} testimonials or reviews on the page repeat each other almost word for word, with only a town or a name changed.

placeholder_names.title: Placeholder names on testimonials
placeholder_names.detail: Some testimonials are signed with a placeholder name such as 'John Doe' or 'Jan Jansen'.

testimonial_dates.title: Testimonials all from the same week
testimonial_dates.detail: All {count} testimonials are dated within a few days of each other.

all_five_testimonials.title: Only 5-star testimonials
all_five_testimonials.detail: All {count} testimonials give 5 stars. A company picks the testimonials it shows: look for reviews on an independent site too.

kvk_malformed.title: KvK number looks wrong
kvk_malformed.detail: The KvK (Chamber of Commerce) number on the site doesn't have the 8 digits every KvK number has.

kvk_missing.title: No KvK number found
kvk_missing.detail: No KvK (Chamber of Commerce) number found on the page, though Dutch businesses must show it on their website. Ask for it, and look the company up at kvk.nl.

licence_no_number.title: Says licensed, no licence number
licence_no_number.detail: The site says it is licensed but shows no licence number. Ask for it: most states let you look contractor, plumbing and electrical licences up online.

names_differ.title: Two company names
names_differ.detail: The site names two different companies: {names}. Check which one you'd be hiring.

bait_callout.title: Very low call-out fee
bait_callout.detail: The page advertises a call-out fee of (almost) nothing ({quote}). The bill is usually made up elsewhere: ask what the whole job will cost.

emergency_pressure.title: Emergency promises
emergency_pressure.detail: The page promises help day and night within minutes ({quote}). In a hurry it's easy to skip the questions: still ask for the price first.

vague_pricing.title: No prices given
vague_pricing.detail: The page gives no prices, only 'on request' ({quote}).

no_street_address.title: No street address
no_street_address.detail: The site doesn't give a street address, only a phone number or a town.

new_on_platform.title: New on the platform
new_on_platform.detail: This provider joined the platform less than six months ago, so there's little track record yet.

few_platform_reviews.title: Few reviews yet
few_platform_reviews.detail: Only {count} reviews on the platform so far.

low_response_rate.title: Often doesn't reply
low_response_rate.detail: Answers only {pct} of requests on the platform.

p2p_advance_payment.title: Payment up front
p2p_advance_payment.detail: The ad asks you to pay before you have the item ({quote}). Pay through the platform, or when you collect it.

p2p_untraceable_payment.title: Payment you can't get back
p2p_untraceable_payment.detail: The ad asks for payment by {method} ({quote}). Money sent that way can't be reclaimed if the item never comes.

p2p_protection_refused.title: Refuses the platform's payment
p2p_protection_refused.detail: The ad rules out paying through the platform ({quote}), which is what protects you as a buyer.

p2p_seller_abroad.title: Seller says they're away
p2p_seller_abroad.detail: The seller says they are abroad or can't meet ({quote}). Ads for goods that never arrive often tell this story.

p2p_photo_in_other_ads.title: Photo used in other ads
p2p_photo_in_other_ads.detail: The main photo is also in {count} other {ads} we checked lately ({platforms}). It may have been copied from someone else's ad.

p2p_price_far_below.title: Price far below the usual
p2p_price_far_below.detail: {evidence} A price this low is a common way to lure buyers.

p2p_bank_transfer.title: Bank transfer asked
p2p_bank_transfer.detail: The ad asks for a bank transfer or a payment link ({quote}). A transfer to a stranger can't be undone: pay through the platform, or when you collect the item.

p2p_shipping_only.title: No pickup
p2p_shipping_only.detail: The seller won't meet ({quote}), so you can't see the item before you pay.

p2p_listing_burst.title: Many ads on a new account
p2p_listing_burst.detail: {count} other ads on an account that's {age} old.

p2p_duplicate_text.title: Same text in other ads
p2p_duplicate_text.detail: The same ad text is in {count} other {ads} we checked in the last 90 days ({platforms}). Ads that aren't what they seem are often posted many times.

p2p_shared_contact.title: Contact details in many ads
p2p_shared_contact.detail: The phone number or e-mail address in this ad is also in {count} other ads we checked in the last 90 days.

p2p_contact_outside.title: Contact outside the platform
p2p_contact_outside.detail: The ad asks you to get in touch by {channel} ({quote}). Keep the conversation on the platform: it is part of its buyer protection.

p2p_llm_off_platform.title: Deal moved off the platform
p2p_llm_off_platform.detail: The ad's wording moves the deal away from the platform ({quote}).

p2p_photo_on_shops.title: Shop photo
p2p_photo_on_shops.detail: The main photo is also on {count} {shops} ({names}), so it may not be a photo of this item. Ask for a photo of your own choosing.

p2p_no_ratings.title: No ratings yet
p2p_no_ratings.detail: The seller has no ratings from earlier buyers yet.

p2p_slow_responses.title: Slow replies
p2p_slow_responses.detail: The platform shows the seller's replies as slow ({said}).

p2p_little_known.title: Little to go on
p2p_little_known.detail: The ad shows too little about the seller or the payment to call it fine. Pay through the platform, or when you collect the item.

service_little_known.title: Little to go on
service_little_known.detail: The page shows too little about who the business is to call it fine. Ask for the company's details and a written quote before you hire.

not_local.title: May not be a local business
not_local.detail: The page itself says the tradesperson you reach through it isn't necessarily based in the town it names ({quote}). Ask who will come, from which company, and where it is based.

trade_town_name.title: Named after a trade, not a company
trade_town_name.detail: The site's name ({site}) is a trade and a place rather than a company name. Sites like this often pass calls on to whoever is free: ask for the company's name and details before you hire.

national_number_only.title: Only a national phone number
national_number_only.detail: The page gives only national phone numbers, no local or mobile one, so it doesn't show where the business is. Ask where the company is based and who will come.

address_elsewhere.title: Address in another town
address_elsewhere.detail: {where}. Ask who will actually come, and from where.

details_on_request.title: Company details only on request
details_on_request.detail: The page gives the company's details only on request ({quote}). A real business shows who it is: ask for its name and registration number before you hire.

unproven_profile.title: New profile, no track record
unproven_profile.detail: This profile joined the platform less than six months ago and has {count} reviews, so the platform can't vouch for it yet.

low_platform_rating.title: Low rating on the platform
low_platform_rating.detail: Rated {rating} of 5 from {count} reviews on the platform. Read what earlier customers say before you hire.

shared_address_sites.title: Address shared with other sites
shared_address_sites.detail: {count} other, unrelated sites give the same postal address. A mail-forwarding or virtual office address can look like this: ask where the company really works from.

vat_registered.title: Registered company
vat_registered.detail: The VAT number checks out in the EU register.

established_domain.title: Established shop
established_domain.detail: This web shop's address has existed for {years} years.

trust_info_present.title: Shop details present
trust_info_present.detail: Return policy and company details are on the page.

natural_reviews.title: Natural-looking reviews
natural_reviews.detail: Ratings are mixed and spread over time, as you'd expect from real buyers.

us_business.title: Company details shown
us_business.detail: The shop names its company ({company}) and a US business address.

protected_payment.title: Payment with buyer protection
protected_payment.detail: The shop mentions {methods}. Paying that way lets you get your money back if something goes wrong.

nothing_found.title: No warning signs
nothing_found.detail: Nothing suspicious found in the listing, the reviews or the page.

service_established.title: Established website
service_established.detail: This website's address has existed for {years} years.

service_identity_nl.title: Company details shown
service_identity_nl.detail: The site shows its KvK number, company name and a street address.

service_identity_us.title: Company details shown
service_identity_us.detail: The site names its company ({company}) and gives a street address.

licence_shown.title: Licence number shown
licence_shown.detail: The site shows a licence number ({licence}) that you can look up with the state.

written_quote.title: Written quote offered
written_quote.detail: The page offers a written quote or a fixed price before the work starts.

service_nothing_found.title: No warning signs
service_nothing_found.detail: Nothing worrying found in what the page says about the business.

p2p_established.title: Established account
p2p_established.detail: The seller has been on the platform for {age}.

p2p_verified.title: Verified account
p2p_verified.detail: The platform shows the seller as verified ({badges}).

p2p_protection.title: Platform payment
p2p_protection.detail: You can pay through the platform's buyer protection.

p2p_pickup.title: Pickup possible
p2p_pickup.detail: You can see the item before you pay.

p2p_normal_price.title: Usual price
p2p_normal_price.detail: The price is in line with what such items go for.

imprint_where_legal_pages: on the page or on the shop's contact and terms pages

p2p_listing.reliable: Nothing worrying stood out in this ad, and the seller has a track record on the platform.
p2p_listing.concerns: Mostly fine, but check the seller before you pay, and pay through the platform or on collection.
p2p_listing.careful: See the points below, and pay only through the platform.
p2p_listing.junk_or_scam: This ad shows patterns of ads where buyers lost their money.

service_headlines.reliable: Nothing worrying stood out about this business on this page.
service_headlines.concerns: A few things are worth checking before you hire: ask for a written quote and the company's details.
service_headlines.careful: Check who this business really is and get a written quote before you hire.
service_headlines.junk_or_scam: This page shows several patterns of businesses that aren't what they seem. Check it elsewhere before you hire.

sources.legal_pages: The shop's terms and legal pages
sources.market_prices: Prices at other shops (Unfret's price records)
sources.review_records: Reviews on other shops Unfret has checked
sources.brand_records: Wikidata and the brand's own website

notes.registry_silent: The domain registry doesn't say how old the address is.
notes.no_photo: No product photo could be read.
notes.quick: Not part of a quick check.
notes.nothing: Nothing on the page to check.

next_steps.reliable: As always, pay with a method that has buyer protection, such as a credit card or PayPal.
next_steps.concerns: Take a closer look at the points above before you buy.
next_steps.careful: Only buy if you can pay with buyer protection (a credit card or PayPal), or buy it from a shop you know.
next_steps.junk_or_scam: Better to buy this from a shop you know.
next_steps.ad_reliable: Pay through the platform, or when you collect the item.
next_steps.ad_concerns: Pay through the platform, or when you collect the item, and keep the conversation on the platform.
next_steps.ad_careful: Don't pay in advance outside the platform: pay through it, or when you collect the item.
next_steps.ad_junk_or_scam: Better to look for this item in another ad.
next_steps.service_reliable: Ask for a written quote before the work starts.
next_steps.service_concerns: Ask for the company's details and a written quote before any work starts.
next_steps.service_careful: Check the company in the business register, and ask who will actually come, before you agree to anything.
next_steps.service_junk_or_scam: Better to find another company for this job.
next_steps.same_product: Compare before you buy: the same product is sold elsewhere, maybe for less.
next_steps.compare_elsewhere: Search for the product under other names: the same item is often sold elsewhere, for less.
next_steps.real_brand: If you want the brand's product, buy it from the brand itself or a shop you know.
next_steps.compare_price: Compare the price at a shop you know: a discount this good is rarely real.
next_steps.shop_reviews: Look for reviews of the shop itself on other sites before you pay, and pay with buyer protection.
next_steps.find_company: Find out which company is behind the shop (name and address) before you pay.
next_steps.returns: Read the delivery and return terms before you buy: returns may be slow or costly.
next_steps.take_time: Ignore the pressure: take your time and compare the offer elsewhere.
next_steps.check_basket: Check the basket before you pay: untick anything you didn't choose and look at the total.
next_steps.read_reviews: Read the lowest-rated reviews, and look for reviews of the product on other sites.
next_steps.buyer_protection: Only pay with a method that lets you get your money back, such as a credit card or PayPal.
next_steps.safety_alert: Read the Safety Gate alert before you buy: the product may not be safe.
next_steps.p2p_pay_safely: Pay through the platform, or when you collect the item, and keep the conversation on the platform.
next_steps.p2p_see_item: Ask to see the item, or for a new photo of it, before you pay.
next_steps.service_quote: Ask for a written quote with a fixed price before any work starts, and pay once it's done.

same_product.title_price: Looks like the same product, sold elsewhere for {price}
same_product.detail: The main photo is the same photo as on {where}{others}.
same_product.detail_price: The main photo is the same photo as on {where}{others}. Unfret saw it there for {price} on {day}.

deep_check.text: A deep check also looks at {adds}.

adds.ad_price: how its price compares with similar ads
adds.provider_profile: the provider's track record on the platform
adds.service_terms: how the provider wants to be paid

cost.free: Uses 1 of your {count} free deep checks.
cost.free_last: Uses your last free deep check.
cost.paused: Free deep checks are back at 00:00 UTC. Deep checks also come in packs, from {price} for {checks}.
cost.packs: Deep checks come in packs, from {price} for {checks}.
cost.x402: A deep check of this page costs {price}.
